headline: Citadel Securities on Market Leverage
detail: Citadel warns that market leverage may build up again after a reset. For you, trading on margin in concentrated tech, this means amplified risk if the market turns. Be cautious.
rec: No action, but be acutely aware of your overall margin usage and position sizing given this macro warning.
